name: media-band-01
title: Media Band 01 - An Editorial Image Beside A Statement
description: A full-width editorial band: one media slot held at a caller's ratio, beside or below a title, a description and one destination. The media is the caller's node, so an image, a video poster or a composed figure can sit in the frame, and the block owns the frame, the ratio, the surface and the order. There is no animation and no shipped image.
